words.definition: an item, especially a vehicle or property, that is rented out
words.example: We picked up our rental car right outside the airport terminal.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們在機場航廈外就取到了租賃汽車。

words.definition: a written guarantee promising to repair or replace a faulty product
words.example: The laptop comes with a one-year warranty against defects.
words.exampleTranslation: 這台筆電附有一年的瑕疵保固。

words.definition: a self-service restaurant, often in a workplace or school
words.example: Employees can get a discounted lunch at the office cafeteria.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工可以在公司自助餐廳享用優惠午餐。

words.definition: a professional cook, especially the head cook in a restaurant
words.example: The hotel hired a new chef to redesign the breakfast menu.
words.exampleTranslation: 飯店聘請了一位新主廚重新設計早餐菜單。

words.definition: a platform or enclosure that carries people between floors of a building
words.example: Take the elevator to the fifth floor for the conference room.
words.exampleTranslation: 搭電梯到五樓就可以到達會議室。

words.definition: the area where visitors are welcomed, or a formal social event
words.example: Please check in at reception before heading to the meeting room.
words.exampleTranslation: 請先到接待處報到，再前往會議室。

words.definition: in a way that is accurate and without mistakes
words.example: Make sure the form is filled out correctly before submitting it.
words.exampleTranslation: 請確認表格正確填寫後再送出。

words.definition: a legal agreement to rent property for a set period of time
words.example: The office lease is due for renewal at the end of the year.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間辦公室的租約到年底就要續約了。

words.definition: a two-wheeled vehicle powered by pedaling
words.example: Many employees commute to work by bicycle in the summer.
words.exampleTranslation: 夏天有很多員工騎腳踏車通勤上班。

words.definition: to formally inform someone of something
words.example: We will notify all customers by email if the shipping date changes.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果出貨日期有變動，我們會用電子郵件通知所有顧客。

words.definition: an advance showing or viewing of something before its official release
words.example: Investors were given a preview of the new product line.
words.exampleTranslation: 投資人得到了新產品線的預覽機會。

words.definition: a person whose job is to help or serve customers in a public place
words.example: A flight attendant offered us drinks shortly after takeoff.
words.exampleTranslation: 起飛後不久，空服員就送上了飲料。

words.definition: an arrangement to receive a product or service regularly by paying in advance
words.example: Our subscription to the industry magazine expires next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們訂閱的產業雜誌下個月就到期了。

words.definition: easy to use or suited to someone's needs without extra effort
words.example: The new office location is more convenient for most staff.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的辦公室地點對大部分員工來說更方便。

words.definition: a book of instructions explaining how to use or operate something
words.example: Refer to the manual if the machine displays an error code.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果機器顯示錯誤代碼，請參考說明書。

words.definition: a piece of information that helps solve a problem or mystery
words.example: The survey results gave us a clue about why sales dropped.
words.exampleTranslation: 調查結果給了我們銷售下滑原因的線索。

words.definition: a building or area used to store vehicles or for vehicle repairs
words.example: The company car is parked in the garage on the first floor.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司用車停在一樓的車庫裡。

words.definition: to get or acquire something, often through effort
words.example: You must obtain approval from your manager before booking travel.
words.exampleTranslation: 你必須先取得主管核准才能訂機票。

words.definition: having a rounded, egg-like shape
words.example: The conference table is oval, so everyone can see each other.
words.exampleTranslation: 這張會議桌是橢圓形的，所以每個人都能看到彼此。

words.definition: a complete list of goods or materials held in stock
words.example: The warehouse team does a full inventory check every quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 倉庫團隊每一季都會做一次完整的庫存盤點。
